project.name: Anatomy Events
project.purpose: Operational rule map for the React/Vite Events App 2.0, Google Sheet sync, permissions, pricing, payouts, and generated-file workflows.

deployment.framework: React + Vite with Cloudflare Pages Functions
deployment.write_proxy: /api/sheet verifies Google ID tokens and forwards allowlisted mutations with encrypted APP_SYNC_TOKEN
deployment.current_state: Cloudflare Pages is the production frontend. Apps Script Version 80 was deployed and its Manual Upcoming Appointment field verified on 2026-08-12.

auth_and_permissions.admin_tools_visibility: Admin and Pricing tabs are visible when canAccessAdminToolsForViewer is true.

retired_systems.view_as: Retired and old viewer override storage is cleared on auth provider load.
retired_systems.admin_promotion: Removed from active Admin UI; do not rebuild without explicit approval.

auth_and_permissions.payout_dropdown_rule: Only full payout access emails can see the full person picker. Other users see only their own payout schedule plus explicit delegated people.
auth_and_permissions.admin_payout_ledger_rule: Admin Tools shows Open Payout Ledger only for full payout access emails.

visible_bottom_tabs.pay: Visible to bypass/admin/super_admin and artist/counter-role viewers.

event_card_buttons.client: Opens Client Details in edit mode. This is the first client-card action and uses the shared contact-style icon.

event_ledger.cancelled_visibility: Cancelled/Canceled and Not Likely to Continue rows remain saved but are hidden from the event lineup.
sort_order: Confirmed statuses appear first, sorted by event date from soonest to latest.

Confirmed: Need To Send Contract/Deposit Invoice, Contract Signed, Deposit Sent, Deposit Paid, Temporary License Submitted/Received, Awaiting Follow Up, Needing Changes, Balance Invoice Sent, Invoice Paid in Full, and Event Complete Balance Late.
Pending statuses appear below confirmed, sorted by event date from soonest to latest; pending includes Post Consult Decision, Deposit Late, Open/blank, and any unclassified legacy status.
Undated cards sort last within their group by client name.
event_ledger.card_money_visibility: Computed Total and Balance are visible only to admin-money viewers and only when status/pay status is not Open/blank.
event_ledger.post_deposit_additions: When status is deposit paid or later and a numeric deposit exists, Added After Deposit Paid is max(0, computed total - deposit/0.30).
event_ledger.manual_appointment_rule: Manual Upcoming Appointment is stored in the Events sheet. Adding the first nonblank appointment automatically applies status New; changing an existing appointment preserves the current status.
event_ledger.google_calendar_button: Removed from the client-card face because the calendar hook was unreliable.
event_ledger.map_button: Shown when venue/address is not TBD and has a usable query.
event_ledger.latest_communication_preview: Shows most recent staff activity entry for visible event IDs.

artist_picker.alias_normalization: Artist aliases such as Lady Shy, Tomma Mueller, Baby J, Meg, etc. are normalized to canonical names.

staff_assignment.save_rule: Saving staff assignment upserts the event to the sheet, then refreshes by Entry ID when possible.

edit_mode.default: Read-only unless opened with edit=1 or pencil is toggled.
edit_mode.event_card_client_button: Passes edit=1 so the page opens editable.

client_details.price_plan_options: Derived from available pricing schedule years.
client_details.historical_lock: Completed, Event Complete Balance Late, Cancelled, and Canceled rows use legacy pricing interpretation.
client_details.open_forward_pricing: Open-forward rows allow travel distance pricing without requiring a full valid address.
client_details.deposit_rule: Deposit paid/later statuses use 30% deposit behavior for balance/addition displays.
client_details.booked_hours_rule: Base includes 5 hours. Booked hours are derived first from Event Start Time to Event End Time when both are present, then from legacy hour-scaling adjustment reason text, then from extraHours. Standard events under 5 hours prorate base and counter; Corporate / Walk-Up events use a five-hour minimum. Hours above 5 add the configured extra-hour charge.
client_details.staff_adjustment: Admin-only section for explicit manual staff price adjustments only. Legacy prorate/hour-scaling reason text may restore Booked Hours, but must display through dedicated prorated pricing rows, not as Staff Adjustment. Staff Adjustment rows are hidden when the amount is zero and imports must not seed staffPriceAdjustment from optionalFee.
client_details.delete_event: Requires confirmation and sends deleteEvent by Entry ID or Source Row.

notes.status_edit_access: Only admin and super_admin effective auth types can edit status.
notes.invoice_paid_in_full_rule: Invoice Paid in Full means the client invoice has been fully paid. It is treated as deposit-paid-or-later for pricing displays, but does not mark the event complete or make it payout-eligible.
notes.activity_log: Staff communication entries store the signed-in viewer name (falling back to email), timestamp, and message; Discord actor entries are removed from visible local log.
notes.manual_upcoming_appointment: Notes can save a manual upcoming appointment timestamp without changing event status. Appointment/calendar hooks are not displayed on client cards.
notes.discord: Specific Entry IDs can post to configured Discord event channels.

pricing.schedule_source: The live Google Sheet Pricing Rules tab is the canonical source for all React app pricing and payout percentages. The local schedule is an offline-only safety snapshot.
pricing.base_rule: Base is plan/year artist-count row baseRatePerArtist5h times artist count; falls back to artistFeeBreakdown when no schedule row exists.
pricing.default_input_state: New/blank Pricing Calculator starts with no Number of Artists selected and Booked Hours visually blank with 5-hour fallback math.
pricing.booked_hours_display_rule: The customer-facing calculator combines base service, counter staff, and licensing into Required Event Price. Standard events under five hours prorate base and counter. Corporate / Walk-Up events never prorate and use a five-hour minimum. Hours above five show Extra Hourly Charge as a modifier.
pricing.counter_charge: counterPerArtist * Number of Artists from pricing schedule for the 5-hour row; effective counter staff scales by bookedHours / 5 when booked hours are not 5.
pricing.radius_fee: No fee through freeRadiusMiles; over free radius, ceil((miles - freeRadiusMiles) / radiusStepMiles) * radiusStepFee.
pricing.mileage_lookup: Pricing page supports Lookup Radius from Address using Anatomy Tattoo, Portland, OR as base address. It writes Travel Distance miles, and radius fee recomputes from travel distance. Manual travel distance remains supported.
page_order: Pricing card with equal-size Share/View actions
2026 pricing table with Artists and 5-Hour Event Price; 2025 remains legacy-only
New Client Entry / Import / Overwrite mode chips
Client name, phone, email, date, start time, end time, venue, event type, and consultation notes
Calculated Total pricing breakdown with compact copy control
pricing_table_order: Required Event Price combining base service, counter staff, and temporary facility licensing for Standard events
Required Event Price combining counter staff, temporary facility licensing, and the $300 Corporate Admin Fee for Corporate / Walk-Up events
Staff Adjustment or entered adjustment reason only when explicit non-zero staffPriceAdjustment exists
pricing.custom_flash: YES applies manual fee if entered, otherwise schedule customFlashFeeEvent; NO/TBD applies 0 in event math unless enabled as YES.
pricing.temporary_tattoos: YES applies manual fee if entered, otherwise schedule tempTattoosFee; NO/TBD applies 0.
pricing.tfl_fee: Fixed charge, not a modifier. Manual fee if entered, otherwise facilityCityFee + facilityAdminFee; not applied until artist count is selected. Apps Script upsert also defaults a blank Temporary Facility License Fee to 200 when Event Address contains OR or Oregon.
pricing.corporate_pricing: Corporate / Walk-Up bills no tattoo base to the event client, applies a five-hour minimum to counter pricing, charges extra hourly only above five hours, and adds a fixed $300 corporate admin fee to cover furniture wear, supplies, and staffing required to keep the tattoo shop open. It requires no deposit and is due in full.
pricing.computed_total: max(0, baseTotal + fixed charges + modifiers + balance add-ons). Credit is currently 0 in app math.

sync.pull_events: Authenticated POST action=events through same-origin Cloudflare /api/sheet.
sync.pull_event: Authenticated POST action=event by Entry ID through same-origin Cloudflare /api/sheet.
sync.pull_pricing: Authenticated POST action=pricing through same-origin Cloudflare /api/sheet.
sync.save_event: Authenticated POST JSON action=upsertEvent through same-origin Cloudflare /api/sheet.
sync.delete_event: Authenticated POST action=deleteEvent through same-origin Cloudflare /api/sheet.
sync.security_boundary: Apps Script version 92 requires APP_SYNC_TOKEN for reads and writes. The token is injected only by Cloudflare after session/Google-credential allowlist verification; direct anonymous Apps Script reads and mutations are rejected.
normalization: Artist names normalize to ED entry values.

Apps Script version 73 contains Oregon Temporary Facility License defaulting in buildEventRowFromPayload_, but the active web app deployment must be redeployed to version 73 by an account in the script owner's domain before this is live.
staffPriceAdjustment is not seeded from optionalFee on import; explicit non-zero staff adjustments can still write optionalFee for legacy Sheet compatibility.
Remote upsert preserves local route id when matching by Entry ID.
guardrails: A sheet pull returning 0 rows while local events exist is treated as an error to avoid accidental wipe.
Local eventCompletedAt is set when status first becomes completed and cleared if status leaves completed.

visibility.payout_ledger: Admin Tools Payout Ledger visible only for full payout access emails.

payouts.person_name_parsing: Names split on comma, newline, semicolon, slash, ampersand; placeholder tokens -, em dash, n/a, na, none are ignored.
payouts.year_filter: Pay and Payout Ledger support All plus completed years, descending.
payouts.completed_year: Uses eventCompletedAt when present; otherwise past completed event date is assumed; otherwise Untracked. Payout cards sort newest completed/event date first and oldest last.

client_card_pages.summary: Events App 2.0 client-card button panels rebuilt as lightweight Vite/React panels. Client Details, Staff Assignments, Notes, and Generators & Files now open from event cards and use Sheet-backed helpers for save/delete/generate actions. Work remains partial until auth gating, live production mutation testing, exact routing semantics, manual appointments, art upload, and email/copy actions are completed.
client_card_pages.detail_page_navigation: Every client-card button page starts with a filled bordered client menu directly under the primary app menu. That client menu contains the large top-left back button, the active event/client name, and the four client-card navigation buttons in this exact order: Client Details, Staff Assignments, Notes, Generators & Files. It must remain visually consistent across Client Details, Staff Assignments, Notes, and Generators & Files. The event card face and every destination page must use the same shared action source so the order cannot drift.
client_card_pages.mobile_requirement: Events App 2.0 pages must remain mobile-first/responsive; action rows stack, forms collapse to one column, chip/link controls must remain reachable on narrow screens, the collapsed top primary nav must keep a fixed 120px header row and fixed button height across every page, and the gap between that nav and the active page content must be consistent across page types. Page-stack headings such as Pay Schedule and Admin Tools render in filled bordered blocks instead of transparent header space; mobile helper copy is hidden and status pills do not wrap taller.
client_card_pages.pending_feedback: Any Sheet-writing save/generate action on Client Details, Staff Assignments, Notes, Generators & Files, or Pricing must dim its page section and show a waiting spinner/message until the Sheet response resolves.
client_card_pages.client_details_save: Client Details saves use Apps Script action=upsertEventPartialJson with V2 Sheet field names so edits write only owned fields and do not silently miss legacy UI keys or wipe unrelated columns.

frontend_rebuild.summary: Events App 2.0 was refactored into focused Vite/React modules and rebuilt with Events, Pricing, Payout, Admin Tools, Payout Ledger, and client-card button panels. The app keeps the Google Sheet / Apps Script source of truth and avoids Expo runtime dependencies.

pwa_installability.detail: The active Vite app now links public/manifest.webmanifest, provides 180px Apple and 192px/512px install icons, uses standalone display with Anatomy theme/background colors, registers a production service worker, and presents install guidance in Admin Tools.
pwa_installability.cache_boundary: The service worker caches only same-origin GET shell/static requests; /api routes, Apps Script requests, mutations, and authentication traffic are not cached. Navigation is network-first with the cached shell as an offline fallback.

spreadsheet_writes.evidence: An unauthenticated upsertEventPartialJson request created diagnostic Entry ID CODEX-NONMUTATING-AUTH-CHECK in production Events row 25; an unauthenticated deleteEvent request then removed that exact row, and a follow-up action=event read confirmed it absent.
spreadsheet_writes.security_fix: APP_SYNC_TOKEN was rotated into a normal Apps Script property and an encrypted Cloudflare Pages secret. React mutations now POST to /api/sheet with a short-lived Google credential; the Pages Function verifies Google's signature, client audience, issuer, expiry, verified email, shared allowlist, and allowed action before forwarding.
spreadsheet_writes.verification: Direct anonymous Apps Script mutation now returns Unauthorized and creates no row. Unsigned Cloudflare proxy mutation returns Authentication failed and creates no row. The deployed app and event reads still load normally.
spreadsheet_writes.remaining_test: Perform one signed-in save and delete of a disposable event through the production UI to verify the complete authorized proxy path.

payout_rules.verified: The eight live Pricing Rules rows match src/pricingMath.js for 2025 and 2026 base rates, counter charges, custom flash fees, hourly rates, temporary tattoo fees, facility fees, deposit rate, radius rules, and percentage splits.
payout_rules.gap: The payout pages use schedule fallback and percentage rules but cannot load authoritative live staff-tab payout overrides. Historical exceptions therefore depend on a small hard-coded map and may be wrong for events with sheet-level overrides not represented in code.
payout_rules.additional_caveat: Resolved 2026-08-09: the live Pricing Rules feed now configures the complete pricing engine; the bundled schedule is used only when the live source cannot load.

automatic_event_payment_reconciliation.scope: All completed, non-cancelled events in the React Payout Ledger.
automatic_event_payment_reconciliation.equation: Gross = Staff Paid + Tomma Captured to Shop + Additional Shop Earnings
rules: Calculate gross from the event pricing inputs whenever the saved Total Charge is blank.
Exclude Tomma from Staff Paid and add her complete tracked allocation to Shop Total.
Show the shop's earnings outside Tomma separately, including facility fees, shop modifier shares, and adjustments.
Keep Remainder visible as an automatic reconciliation check; expected value is zero.

selectable_pricing_methods.legacy_compatibility: Blank Pricing Method resolves to STANDARD. collectFullPayout is an independent payment-timing field and never selects the pricing method.
selectable_pricing_methods.STANDARD: Event client invoice includes tattoo base and modifiers.
selectable_pricing_methods.CORPORATE_MODIFIERS: Event client invoice excludes tattoo base and includes counter, facility/admin licensing, custom flash, temporary tattoos, radius, extra hourly, and explicit adjustment amounts. Walk-up tattoo transactions are neither entered nor reported in this app.
selectable_pricing_methods.downstream_rule: Company invoice total, payment timing, payout modifier shares, and payout-ledger gross must all use the saved pricing method.
selectable_pricing_methods.event_card_indicator: Standard pricing has no badge. Corporate / Walk-Up shows a single gold $ between the event-type icon and client name.
selectable_pricing_methods.corporate_payment_rule: Corporate / Walk-Up has no deposit; the complete company invoice is due in full.
selectable_pricing_methods.corporate_proration_rule: Corporate / Walk-Up never prorates the five-hour package or counter charge for shorter events; extra-hour charges begin only after five hours.
selectable_pricing_methods.walk_up_revenue_rule: Artists keep walk-up tattoo revenue, but those transactions are never entered or reported anywhere in this system.
selectable_pricing_methods.corporate_payout_rule: Artist modifier percentages and counter allocations come from the live Pricing Rules row selected by plan year and artist count; the shop receives the remainder.
selectable_pricing_methods.deployment_status: Events!AQ and Apps Script Version 78 are live. The production API round-trips Pricing Method independently from collectFullPayout.
